context: A police officer briefs about a case
purpose: Teach: 漏洩/細菌/噴火/波及/苦戦/スキャンダル/万一/同調

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 情報漏洩、警察庁、本格的に調査開始しました。
lines.en: We've launched a full investigation into the information leak with the National Police Agency.
lines.style: Measured, official but not cold. Clear enunciation on the key facts. Steady pace. No apology in the tone — this is procedural, competent work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病院では、細菌感染も、注意点ですね。
lines.en: At hospitals, bacterial infection is another thing to watch out for, isn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely interested. Soft lilt upward on the question particle. Leaning forward slightly — connecting the dots aloud, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。今月、噴火警報、別件で出ています。
lines.en: Yes. We also had an eruption alert issued this month — separate issue.
lines.style: Crisp, informative. No inflection on the separateness — just stating fact. Professional distance. Slight pause before "separate" to mark the pivot.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 金融への波及、業界全体で警戒、必要ですね。
lines.en: The financial sector needs the whole industry to stay vigilant about the ripple effects.
lines.style: Careful, almost cautious in the phrasing. Not urgent, but serious underneath. Slight hesitation before "vigilant" — choosing the right word matters here.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。捜査、苦戦している地域もあります。
lines.en: Yes. There are some areas where the investigation is hitting obstacles.
lines.style: Steady, honest acknowledgment. No defensiveness, but quiet professionalism — this is how work actually goes. Even pace, slight weight on "obstacles."

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 政治のスキャンダル、メディアが大々的に報じてますね。
lines.en: The media's given the political scandal pretty heavy coverage.
lines.style: Observational, almost neutral. Not gossipy — just noting what's happened. Light, conversational tone. The slight tilt of someone tracking public conversation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 万一に備え、警備、強化しています。
lines.en: We're strengthening security just in case something escalates.
lines.style: Factual, no melodrama. Calm reassurance in the delivery. This is precaution, not panic. Even breath, clear priority in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 業界、警察の声に同調する動き、ありますか。
lines.en: Is the industry moving to align itself with the police position on any of this?
lines.style: Genuinely probing. Slight upward lilt on the question — really wanting the answer. Lean-in quality. Smart follow-up, not accusatory.
